title: Proof tester acceptance probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ be a list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over $\mathbb F_2$, let $w:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $p:\{0,\ldots,2^n+2^{n^2}-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The acceptance probability of the four-query proof tester for $L$ on the combined word consisting of $w$ and $p$ equals the acceptance probability of the three-query character tester for $L$ on the function that maps each binary matrix $A$ to the value of $p$ at the proof-table position indexed by the flattening of $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over $\mathbb F_2$
$w$ is a Boolean word of length $n$
$p$ is a Boolean proof table of length $2^n+2^{n^2}$
